page.overview:
What is G-5?

G-5, officially , is a Marine Base located in the New World, near the Red Line. It was first mentioned by Aokiji after the Summit War of Marineford and according to him, it is full of problems. Smoker requested a transfer to this branch in order to "keep his targets close".

Initially opposed to the Straw Hat Pirates, the unit teamed up with them and the Heart Pirates to stop Caesar Clown on Punk Hazard, and so they serve as major allies in the Punk Hazard Arc.

The base seems to be very close to the Red Line since Vice Admiral Smoker and Captain Tashigi were the first to intercept the pirates fleeing Fish-Man Island and entering the New World.

The headquarters of the G-5 location has several buildings left tattered or broken and slightly fixed from damages and appears to be left in ruins.
